title: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac rally as Ackman presses for conservatorship exit
summary_full: The midterm elections could be a turning point for the release of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac from government control, according to Bill Ackman.
summary_public: The midterm elections could be a turning point for the release of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac from government control, according to Bill Ackman.
